title: Peel and Mince Garlic Cloves
summary: Take garlic from the pantry drawer, separate cloves, peel them with a knife, then trim and mince for cooking.

nodes.name: Get garlic bulb from storage
nodes.instruction_novice: Open the produce drawer and take out a garlic bulb. Pick one that feels firm.
nodes.end_state: A garlic bulb is in hand with the drawer closed.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get garlic bulb from storage?

nodes.name: Grab knife and cutting board
nodes.instruction_novice: Get a small sharp knife and a cutting board. Set them on the counter near you.
nodes.end_state: Knife and cutting board sit on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Grab knife and cutting board?

nodes.name: Separate cloves from bulb
nodes.instruction_novice: Press the bulb with your palm to loosen it, then pull off the cloves you need.
nodes.end_state: Individual garlic cloves lie separated on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Separate cloves from bulb?

nodes.name: Trim root end of clove
nodes.instruction_novice: Slice off the hard root end of each clove with the knife. Keep your fingers clear of the blade.
nodes.end_state: Each clove has its flat root end cut off.

checks.question: Is this step done: Trim root end of clove?

nodes.name: Peel the cloves
nodes.instruction_novice: Use the knife tip or your fingernail to lift the papery skin and peel it away. Lightly crushing the clove with the flat of the blade makes this easier.
nodes.end_state: Clean white cloves are free of papery skin.

checks.question: Is this step done: Peel the cloves?

nodes.name: Discard the skins
nodes.instruction_novice: Gather the papery skins and throw them in the trash or compost.
nodes.end_state: The counter is clear of garlic skins.

checks.question: Is this step done: Discard the skins?

nodes.name: Slice cloves thinly
nodes.instruction_novice: Lay a clove flat on the board and cut it into thin slices. Curl your fingertips under while cutting.
nodes.end_state: Cloves are cut into thin slices on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Slice cloves thinly?

nodes.name: Mince garlic finely
nodes.instruction_novice: Rock the knife back and forth over the slices until the pieces are tiny. Scrape them into a pile and repeat.
nodes.end_state: A small pile of finely minced garlic sits on the board.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mince garlic finely?

nodes.name: Transfer garlic to bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Use the flat of the knife to scoop the minced garlic into a small bowl.
nodes.end_state: The minced garlic is in a small bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Transfer garlic to bowl?

nodes.name: Rinse knife and board
nodes.instruction_novice: Wash the knife and board in the sink and dry them so they're ready for the next step.
nodes.end_state: The clean knife and board are drying beside the sink.

checks.question: Is this step done: Rinse knife and board?
